name: outlook-assistant
description: Microsoft Outlook email, calendar and contacts for Claude: 22 tools via Microsoft Graph, with dry-run previews, send limits and recipient allowlists. Works with Outlook.com and Microsoft 365.

client_id.title: Azure application (client) ID
client_id.description: The Application (client) ID of your own Azure app registration. Not a secret. Leave blank to enter it later, when you first ask Claude to connect to Outlook.

auth_audience.title: Sign-in audience
auth_audience.description: Must match your Azure app's supported account types: common (personal and work/school), consumers (personal only), organizations (work/school only) or a tenant ID.

max_emails_per_session.title: Send limit per session
max_emails_per_session.description: Maximum emails, drafts sent and rule changes per session. 0 means no limit.

allowed_recipients.title: Allowed recipients
allowed_recipients.description: Optional comma-separated domains or addresses that email can be sent to. Leave blank to allow all recipients.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to true to refuse every change (sending, drafts, moves, deletes, rules, settings) and allow only reads and sign-in. false allows changes.

confirm_level.title: Confirmation level
confirm_level.description: When the safety hook asks you first: outward (default) before anything that emails or notifies other people, deletes, or keeps acting (rules, forwarding, automatic replies); all-writes before every change; off never (not recommended). Reads and dry-run previews never ask.
